'''Bacta Bath and Beauty Works''' was a business venture that was run by [[Famier Denzmorren]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. After a batch of [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] that he had purchased cheaply and was trying to sell turned out to be parasitic, he was forced to flee the system to evade the local authorities, ending the venture.
